summary: Nova Scotia fire tower in Queens, listed near Menchan Lake in 2009; the province decommissioned its towers in 2015 and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Nova Scotia decommissioned its lookout towers in 2015 and later dismantled them; no source describes what remains at this site.

notes_for_editor: The record's status_note says the towers closed in 2013 and cites CBC News. The CBC article I could read gives 2015 for decommissioning and does not mention 2013. A CBC story on staffing cuts that may support 2013 timed out twice, so 2013 is unverified and left out of the story. The only tower-specific source is a 2009 scanner-listener list that warns some towers may already be gone. No source describes the site today, and no build date, height or design was found.
